rawBlockNode.name: cat-card-b-0
rawBlockNode.content: The VanMoof A5 is an e-bike perfect for agile city rides. Find out more about this e-bike model, buy now and ride in 7 days.

rawBlockNode.name: cat-card-b-1
rawBlockNode.content: Our Front Rack is compatible with the VanMoof S5 & A5 e-bike. Designed to carry up to 10 kg weight. Includes elastic cord to fasten items.

rawBlockNode.name: cat-card-b-2
rawBlockNode.content: Our tech smart e-bikes are designed for the city. Discover more about our story on city mobility.

rawBlockNode.name: cat-card-b-3
rawBlockNode.content: Meet your ultimate phone mount. An exclusive, integrated design built to keep your device smartly locked in and secure.

rawBlockNode.name: cat-card-b-4
